beats.text: The first video on YouTube is about elephants’ trunks.
beats.note: Jawed Karim uploaded Me at the zoo on 23 April 2005, at 8:31 pm Pacific time.

beats.name: Jawed Karim
beats.role: YouTube co-founder who appears in the clip, filmed at the San Diego Zoo.

beats.context: The length of the video. Sources vary by about a second.

beats.text: A school friend, Yakov Lapitsky, filmed it.
beats.note: Wikipedia describes him as Karim’s high school friend.

beats.text: The cool thing, he says, is that elephants have really, really, really long trunks.
beats.note: That is the whole point of the video, and the reason it is the most famous upload on the site.

beats.text: The San Diego Zoo left a pinned comment in 2020.
beats.note: Wikipedia reports it became the most liked comment on the platform, with 4.7 million likes.

beats.text: More than 416 million views, as of September 2026, for 19 seconds of elephants.

beats.line: Big platforms start with tiny uploads.
